name: ProShop Privacy Router (mirror of backend/assistant/router.js)
_comment: STRETCH (PLAN T8.3). Visual mirror of the code router: a webhook receives {message}, a Function node runs the SAME regex/intent PII scan as backend/assistant/pii.js, then an IF node forks LOCAL (PII/intent present) vs CLOUD (clean). The application's source of truth is the code in router/router.js + router/pii.js; this JSON exists only to make the decision visible in n8n form.
